text:
olivia: quick q — we're migrating `inference-cache` from Deployment -> StatefulSet so we can use stable PVCs per pod. i want to make sure rollout strategy + terraform changes are safe for prod. main concerns: ordinal-based sticky cache, graceful draining, and avoiding double-writes during overlap. any gotchas?
sam: +1. main thing is to avoid two pods claiming same PVC. use volumeClaimTemplates in the sts spec, not pre-created PVCs. that way each replica gets its own PVC named by ordinal.
matt: also consider `podManagementPolicy: Parallel` vs `OrderedReady`. for caching we probably want `OrderedReady` so scale down/up is sequential — less risk of two replicas trying to warm same slot.
olivia: good point. our traffic is bursty; wondering about `rollingUpdate.partition` for canarying new image. would partition help here?
nisha: yes — `spec.updateStrategy.rollingUpdate.partition` lets you freeze a portion of the sts at an old revision. good for manual canaries. infra note: Terraform state will need the StatefulSet resource update; ensure `kubernetes_stateful_set` resource in TF is changed and we're not re-creating PVCs.
sam: example snippet for partitioned rollouts:```yaml
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 2
```
matt: also set `maxUnavailable`/`maxSurge` are for Deployments only. For STS you control via partition + replicas. readiness probe delays matter — if warmup takes time, set `readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds` and `failureThreshold` so it doesn't kill during warm cache build.
olivia: Terraform question — we currently create 3 PVCs manually. if we switch to volumeClaimTemplates, do we need to delete the old PVCs first? or will k8s reconcile?
nisha: you must migrate data if you care about existing PVC content. k8s won't transfer data automatically. recommended pattern: create new sts with new label (or temporarily scale down old) and run a migration job to copy data, or accept cold-start.
matt: small ops tip: use `preStop` hook to flush cache and `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60` to give time. example:```yaml
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh","-c","/app/flush-cache && sleep 10"]
terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
```
olivia: re secrets wiring — the cache service reads S3 creds and a KMS key from k8s secret. switching STS shouldn't affect secrets but watch for serviceAccount changes in the TF module. any warnings?
sam: ensure the `serviceAccountName` remains the same or the IAM role bindings (IRSA) won't attach. TF change: update `kubernetes_stateful_set` resource `spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName` accordingly.
nisha: I'll add a small TF plan checklist in the PR: bump resource, remove manual PVC creation, add volumeClaimTemplates, verify SA name stays, ensure lifecycle preStop, update probes.
olivia: awesome. can someone review the PR once i open it? i'll include the migration plan (cold start vs copy job) and a smoke test. @matt @sam please.
matt: I'll review tomorrow AM. remind me to check rollout_time metrics. :eyes:
sam: ping me after CI passes. also add a quick perf test to mimic 95th percentile traffic.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline status: plan started for branch `feature/sts-cache-migrate` — 3 resources to change. (click to view) :gear:
olivia: thanks all — i'll do the PR now and add the checklist. will tag you when ready.
